newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Monday morning:

** At the auspicious "moorat" Hindu new year trading on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Sunday, the BSE 30-share index closed marginally higher at 3080.26, 13.60 points or 0.44 percent from the previous close.
** Dealers said most domestic institutions made only token purchases on Sunday. Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were conspicuous by their absence, they said.
** Blue-chips like Larsen & Toubro, Reliance Industries, ITC and MTNL see selling pressure towards end of trading.
** The BSE closed on Monday but the National Stock Exchange is open. Most regional stock exchanges closed on Monday.

** Three more officials of beleagured ITC arrested on Sunday for alleged violation of the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act. The company is under investigation in a $100 million foreign exchange scandal.

** President & Fellows of Harvard College, the University of Toronto Global Pool and the Stanford University Endowment Fund are amongst the first university and endowment funds which have expressed interest in investing in Indian markets and registering with the Securities and Exchange Board of India, The Economic Times reports.
** The Indian rupee opened steady at 35.72/73 per dollar. The day's range seen at 35.71/74 rupees to a dollar
